items.title_ru: Затопление подводной станции
items.summary_ru: Один непрерывный кадр: Оуэн в коридоре станции, лопается труба, лампы гаснут по очереди, он берёт жёлтый фонарь, вода поднимается, он ныряет к люку. Ждём единый дубль, честную воду, фонарь как источник света и Оуэна как на листе.

checks.detail_ru: Ни одной склейки, наплыва или скачка кадра за 20 с.
Лицо, седая щетина, тёмно-синий бушлат и кепка как на @Image1 весь ролик; намокшая шерсть темнеет и тяжелеет, а не сухая.
Переборки, трубы, круглые лампы и люк в конце коридора совпадают с @Image2; планировка не меняется по ходу дубля.
Струя всё время бьёт из лопнувшего шва трубы на левой стене в правую стену, не меняет место и направление.
Потолочные лампы гаснут по одной, от ближней к дальней, ни одна не загорается снова; красная аварийная лампа над люком остаётся.
Жёлтый фонарь как на @Image3; после включения его луч двигается вместе с рукой и освещает стены, воду и лицо; под водой луч виден в мути.
Вода только поднимается: щиколотки → пояс → грудь → подбородок; ни разу не опускается и не скачет.
Пузыри идут вверх, звук глохнет ровно в момент ухода камеры под воду; тьма читается, без чёрной каши.

items.reference_mapping: @Image1 = CH_OWEN: identity and wardrobe of the only person (face, stubble, build, navy peacoat, flat cap). @Image2 = LO_STATION: the corridor — bulkheads, pipes, round ceiling lamps, hatch at the far end, materials and light. @Image3 = PR_LANTERN_1: the yellow emergency lantern — shape, colour, handle and lens.
items.prompt:
[Core Task]
[Reference Mapping] @Image1 is the character sheet of the only person in the scene, Owen: it defines his face, grey stubble, heavy build and his clothes — the navy wool peacoat and flat cap. @Image2 is the location: the deep-sea station corridor, with its bulkheads, pipes and cable runs, the line of round ceiling lamps and the round hatch at the far end. @Image3 is the prop: the yellow emergency lantern, its exact shape, colour, handle and lens. Reproduce each reference exactly; @Image2 is the one and only location.
Live-action survival scene, one continuous 20-second shot with no cuts. The corridor of @Image2 is a compartment of a research station on the ocean floor that starts to flood. Owen from @Image1 is alone in it, working at a wall console near the camera end of the corridor. The yellow lantern from @Image3 hangs switched off in a bracket on the right wall beside him. Above the far hatch glows one red emergency lamp; the hatch window glows dim white from inside.

[Plot Summary]
Shot 1 (one continuous take), 00:00-00:20:
00:00-00:03: Medium shot from behind Owen's right shoulder at the console. A thick pipe on the left wall bursts at a welded joint with a bang; a white high-pressure jet of seawater blasts horizontally across the corridor and slams into the right wall, spraying back in a fan. He flinches and turns toward it.
00:03-00:07: The spray reaches the ceiling wiring and the round ceiling lamps short out one at a time, nearest first, each with a spark, about one second apart, each leaving the corridor darker, until only the red emergency lamp and the hatch glow remain. Water spreads across the floor and climbs past his ankles.
00:07-00:10: In the near-dark he pulls the yellow lantern from its bracket and thumbs its switch; a hard white beam snaps on. From now on the lantern is the main light: its beam swings with his hand across the wet pipes, the jet and the black water, and bounces soft light up onto his face. The water is at his knees, his peacoat hem soaking dark.
00:10-00:14: He wades to the red valve wheel under the burst pipe, water at his waist, hooks the lantern on his forearm and heaves the wheel with both hands and his whole weight. The corroded wheel stays jammed. The jet keeps roaring from the same joint and the water climbs to his chest; the soaked wool of the peacoat clings heavy and black.
00:14-00:17: He gives up, turns toward the far hatch and pushes through the water, the lantern held high. The water reaches his chin, the ceiling a hand's width above his head; the flat cap floats off and drifts away. He takes one deep gasping breath and ducks under.
00:17-00:20: The camera dips under the surface with him. In murky green-black water the lantern beam cuts a visible cone through drifting particles; a trail of silver bubbles rises from his mouth, his coat billows slowly. He swims toward the glowing hatch, grabs its rim with his free hand and pulls himself through.

[Audio Style]
Native location sound only. A metallic bang and a roaring hiss as the pipe bursts, the jet drumming on the right wall, an electrical crack and fizz each time a lamp dies, the click of the lantern switch, a slow emergency alarm pulse, steel groaning under pressure, his ragged cold breathing and a strained grunt at the valve, heavy splashing as he wades. At the exact moment the camera goes under, all sound drops to a muffled low roar with his bubbles and a distant alarm.

[Camera Work and Core Constraints]
One unbroken handheld move close to Owen at chest height, following him down the corridor of @Image2, lowering to the waterline as the water rises and going under with him. Owen's face, build and clothes match @Image1 throughout; wet wool darkens and hangs heavy. The water level rises steadily the whole time and never drops. The jet keeps coming from the same burst joint on the left wall. Light is motivated only by the ceiling lamps while they work, the sparks, the red emergency lamp, the hatch glow and, after 00:08, the lantern beam, which moves with his hand. The scene grows darker with each lamp yet his face and the water surface stay readable. The lantern keeps the exact shape and yellow colour of @Image3. 35 mm film look, visible grain, desaturated cold blue-green and black, real water with weight and foam, real skin with pores.

[Negative Prompt]
subtitles, on-screen text, watermark, music, cuts

items.prompt:
[Core Task]
[Reference Mapping] @Image1 is the character sheet of the only person, Jay: it defines his face, short twists, athletic build, the charcoal zip track jacket and the white trainers. @Image2 is the location: the volcanic sea cliff with turquoise water about 15 meters below, at noon; it is the one and only location. @Image3 is the prop: the small black action camera on a wrist strap. Reproduce each reference exactly.
Live-action cliff-diving sequence in six shots, one continuous scene at midday. Open ocean on the left of frame, the cliff on the right in every shot. The sun stands almost straight overhead: short hard shadows, bright sparkling highlights on the water. Jay arrives at the edge in his track jacket over plain black swim shorts, barefoot, his trainers already set on the rock, the action camera from @Image3 strapped to his left wrist. The same Jay appears in every shot.

[Plot Summary]
Shot 1, 00:00-00:03: Extreme wide from a small boat, long lens, the swell gently rocking the frame. The cliff of @Image2 fills the right two thirds; Jay is a small figure on the very edge, upper right. A swell slams into the foot of the cliff and bursts upward in a white sheet.
Shot 2, 00:03-00:07: Medium shot at the edge, low angle from the rock, Jay on the left third against the bright sky. He unzips the charcoal track jacket, drops it on the rock beside his white trainers, presses the button on the action camera on his left wrist — its small red light starts blinking — takes one slow breath, gives a small nod, and pushes off with both legs out of frame.
Shot 3, 00:07-00:10: The camera descends on a cable rig beside him at his speed, holding his side profile on the right half of frame while the black cliff streams upward behind him. He accelerates under gravity, the fall lasts under two seconds, arms coming together above his head just before the water.
Shot 4, 00:10-00:13: Point of view from the action camera on his left wrist: ultra-wide fisheye image, the edge of his forearm and fingers at the bottom of frame, the turquoise surface rushing up and filling the frame; impact, a white burst, then the image turns green-blue and full of bubbles.
Shot 5, 00:13-00:16.5: Underwater, looking up at the bright rippling surface. He has just entered, a dense column of silver bubbles trailing behind him, sun caustics dancing over his body, the red light of the wrist camera still blinking. He arches, turns upward and kicks toward the light.
Shot 6, 00:16.5-00:20: High angle from the cliff edge looking straight down, the dropped track jacket and the trainers on the rock in the lower left foreground. Far below he surfaces, pushes the water off his face, lifts the wrist camera toward the sky and shouts "Got it!" (in English), then laughs. Hold on him small at the right of frame.

[Audio Style]
Natural location sound only. Steady wind and surf booming against the cliff, the zipper and the soft drop of the jacket on rock, a small electronic beep from the camera button, his deep inhale, rushing air during the fall, a sharp clean plunk on entry heard through the camera's housing in the POV shot, a muffled underwater roar of bubbles, a gasp on surfacing, his shout "Got it!" echoing off the cliff and his laughter.

[Camera Work and Core Constraints]
Six shots, each with a new scale, angle and move: boat long lens, low static medium, descending cable rig, wrist-camera fisheye POV, underwater, high angle. Screen direction holds: ocean on the left, cliff on the right, he dives from the right toward the water. Jay's face and hair match @Image1 in every shot; the action camera stays on his left wrist and matches @Image3. The jacket stays where he dropped it. Midday light identical across shots. Real body weight and true gravity, physically correct water and splash, real skin with pores and real wet hair. Off-centre compositions, natural photographic realism, fine film grain, true colour.

[Negative Prompt]
subtitles, on-screen text, watermark, music, slow motion

items.prompt:
[Core Task]
[Reference Mapping] @Image1 is the character sheet of Maya: her face, short black bob, mustard corduroy jacket over a grey hoodie. @Image2 is the character sheet of Owen: his face, grey stubble, heavy build, navy wool peacoat and flat cap. @Image3, @Image4 and @Image5 are three photos of the same car: an unbadged 1970s two-door fastback in deep blue with chrome bumpers; they define its body, colour, chrome and details from every side. @Image6 is the location: a rainy downtown street at night with wet asphalt and shop lights; it is the one and only location, and every sign and storefront stays plain and without readable lettering.
A 25-second live-action night drama scene in eight shots. The fastback from @Image3–@Image5 is parked at the curb of the street from @Image6 in steady rain, engine idling, wipers running. Maya sits in the driver's seat on the left, Owen in the passenger seat on the right. They are arguing: Owen has sold the car without asking her. The 180-degree line runs between them: in every interior shot Maya is on the left of frame and Owen on the right.

[Plot Summary]
Shot 1, 00:00-00:03: Exterior wide, front three-quarter from across the street, slow push in. The deep-blue fastback at the curb under shop light, rain bouncing off the hood and chrome, the wipers sweeping once; two shadowy figures inside.
Shot 2, 00:03-00:06.5: Interior two-shot from the back seat between their shoulders, the rain-streaked windshield blurring the shop lights into soft colour, the wipers sweeping. Maya stares ahead and says flatly: "You sold it. Without asking me." (in English)
Shot 3, 00:06.5-00:10: Medium close-up of Owen from the driver's side, the rain on his window throwing moving streak-shadows across his face, a cold blue from the street. He rubs his stubble and answers, tired: "It's a car, Maya. It's just a car." (in English)
Shot 4, 00:10-00:13.5: Close-up of Maya from the passenger side, warm dashboard glow from below, her eyes wet but steady. She turns to him: "It's the last thing he fixed." (in English) Her voice cracks on the last word.
Shot 5, 00:13.5-00:16: Close-up of Owen, tighter than shot 3. He holds her look, then looks away to the window: "The buyer comes Friday." (in English)
Shot 6, 00:16-00:19: Insert, close at the steering column. Maya's hand turns the key and pulls it out of the ignition; the engine dies, the dashboard lights go dark and the wipers stop mid-glass. She closes her fist around the keys.
Shot 7, 00:19-00:22: Interior two-shot from the back seat again, now darker, rain sheeting freely down the still windshield. Owen holds out his open hand: "Give me the keys." (in English) Maya, not looking at him: "Get out of my car." (in English)
Shot 8, 00:22-00:25: Exterior, side angle on the passenger door. Owen shoves the long door open, steps out into the rain, turns up his collar, slams the door and walks off to the right of frame, his peacoat darkening with rain. Through the rain-covered side window Maya sits still, the wipers stopped.

[Audio Style]
Native sound only. Inside the car: rain drumming on the roof as a close, muffled patter, the rhythmic thump of the wipers, the idle of the engine, the leather creak of seats, both voices close and intimate, each a distinct voice with exact lip sync. The engine and the wipers stop with a click when the key comes out, leaving only rain. When the door opens the rain and street hiss jump loud, then the heavy door slam cuts them back to the muffled patter. No music.

[Camera Work and Core Constraints]
Eight shots, adjacent shots change scale and angle: exterior wide, back-seat two-shot, singles on opposite sides of the 180-degree line, a key insert, exterior side. Maya always on the left of frame, Owen on the right inside the car; their eyelines meet across the cut. Faces and clothes match @Image1 and @Image2 in every shot. The car keeps the exact body, deep-blue paint, chrome bumpers and interior of @Image3–@Image5, with no badges and no lettering on plates. The wipers move only while the key is in the ignition. Light is motivated only by the shop windows, street lamps and dashboard; colours of the shop lights stay the same across shots. Rain is present on the glass in every interior shot. 35 mm anamorphic film look, deep blacks with readable faces, real skin with pores, wet surfaces with true reflections.

[Negative Prompt]
subtitles, on-screen text, watermark, music, logos

items.prompt:
[Core Task]
[Reference Mapping] @Image1 is the character sheet of the creator, Maya: it defines her face and her short black bob; at home she wears only the grey hoodie from that sheet, without the jacket. @Image2, @Image3 and @Image4 are three photos of the same product: the PEBBLE face serum, a frosted glass dropper bottle with a sage label; they define its shape, glass, dropper, label and the exact spelling PEBBLE from the front, the side and in the hand. @Image5 is the location: the bathroom of her apartment; it is the one and only location.
Authentic get-ready-with-me skincare video shot on a phone front camera, vertical, held at arm's length by Maya herself, real creator energy with quick natural jump cuts between takes. Morning, soft daylight in the bathroom from @Image5. Her skin is natural with visible pores and a little shine, no heavy makeup. The same bottle appears in every shot where the product is visible.

[Plot Summary]
Shot 1, 00:00-00:02.5: Her face already close and off-centre in the upper half of frame, mid-thought; she leans in and says fast, half-embarrassed: "Okay, I was not gonna post this, but look at my skin." (in English)
Shot 2, 00:02.5-00:05: Jump cut, closer. She turns and brings her left cheek almost to the lens; the autofocus hunts, then lands on real skin texture in the window light; her fingertip taps the cheek. "Like... look." (in English)
Shot 3, 00:05-00:08.5: Jump cut, slightly wider. She holds the PEBBLE bottle up beside her face, label toward the lens: "This is the only thing I changed." (in English) She squeezes the dropper bulb and exactly two clear drops fall onto her fingertips.
Shot 4, 00:08.5-00:11.5: She spreads the serum over both cheeks, then pats them with quick soft taps, the skin catching a dewy sheen, a small proud smile into the lens: "Two drops. That's it." (in English)
Shot 5, 00:11.5-00:14.5: Jump cut, wider, the phone now propped on the sink ledge, a lower angle. She tucks her bob behind her left ear and slides one small gold hoop earring into it while saying: "Two weeks. No filter, I swear." (in English)
Shot 6, 00:14.5-00:17.5: Jump cut, close on her hand and face. She turns the bottle slowly in the light so the frosted glass and the side of the sage label show, then sets it down on the sink edge with a soft clink. The gold hoop stays in her left ear.
Shot 7, 00:17.5-00:20: She leans fast toward the phone until her face nearly fills the frame, the focus hunts for a beat, she laughs and says: "...yeah. Link's in bio." (in English), reaching toward the screen to stop recording, ending on the same close, off-centre framing as the first frame.

[Audio Style]
Her voice close to the phone microphone, fast casual American delivery with natural breaths and laughter, lip sync matching every word. Small bathroom echo, the faint squeeze-click of the dropper, soft taps of fingertips on skin, the tiny clink of the bottle on the sink, a quiet ventilation hum. No music.

[Camera Work and Core Constraints]
Phone front-camera capture: wide selfie lens with slight edge distortion, arm's-length handheld wobble, autofocus and auto-exposure breathing, phone sharpening and mild compression. Jump cuts only at the shot boundaries above; across every cut the same Maya from @Image1, the same grey hoodie, bob, window light and bathroom from @Image5. The bottle matches @Image2–@Image4 from every side and the label always reads PEBBLE correctly. Her face and the label stay inside the central safe area of the vertical frame, clear of the top and bottom edges. Real hands with five fingers, the serum behaving like a thin clear liquid.

[Negative Prompt]
subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, music, beauty filter

items.prompt:
[Core Task]
[Reference Mapping] @Image1 is the character sheet of the interviewer, Dev: his face, trimmed beard, orange rain shell, grey cap, black cargo pants and plain messenger bag. @Image2 is the character sheet of the passer-by, Ana: her face, dark hair in a low bun, white double-breasted chef jacket, black apron and the burn scar on her forearm. @Image3 is the location: a downtown sidewalk in daytime with mixed shops; it is the one and only location, and every sign and storefront stays plain without readable lettering.
Vertical street-interview video shot on a handheld phone by an unseen camera operator, sunny afternoon. Dev is a courier who runs a street-interview channel between deliveries; he holds a small black handheld microphone with a red foam windscreen in his right hand the whole time. Ana is a chef walking back to her restaurant on a break. Background pedestrians pass naturally.

[Plot Summary]
Shot 1, 00:00-00:03: Medium two-shot, the camera walking backward. Dev steps into Ana's path, grinning, the microphone at his own mouth: "Quick one: worst advice you ever got?" (in English) He swings the microphone to her.
Shot 2, 00:03-00:07: Tighter on Ana, the microphone in the lower left of frame pointed at her mouth. She thinks for a beat, then quotes, mock-sweet: "Do what you love and you'll never work a day in your life." (in English)
Shot 3, 00:07-00:10.5: Slightly wider on Ana. She pushes up her sleeve and holds her scarred forearm toward the lens, deadpan: "I'm a chef. Nine years. No days off." (in English)

Shot 1 (one continuous take), 00:00-00:20:

Exactly one knife exists, always in someone's hand. Geography of @Image3 holds for the whole take: refrigerator on frame-left, counter and cabinets behind, window at back right, round table in the foreground. Light comes only from the moonlit window and the refrigerator: a strip while ajar, full cold light once open. Maya and Owen match @Image1 and @Image2 throughout. [Reference Mapping] @Image1–@Image3 are three photos of the same car, the hero car: an unbadged 1970s two-door fastback in deep blue with chrome bumpers, its exact body shape, paint, wheels and details, with no badges and no readable plates. @Image4 is the pursuer: a plain white 1990s pickup truck, unbadged, its exact shape. @Image5 is Dev, the fastback's driver: his face, trimmed beard, plain orange rain shell and grey cap. @Image6 is the location: the desert canyon two-lane road between red rock walls at midday, and its light.
A 30-second live-action car chase in ten shots, one continuous scene at midday on the canyon road of @Image6. Hard high sun, short sharp shadows, a light crosswind from the right. Both vehicles travel left to right on screen for the whole sequence and the pickup is always behind the fastback until it leaves the road. The pickup's driver stays a dark shape behind its dusty windshield. Further along the road there is an S-bend and then a low crest where the road rises over a dry wash.

[Plot Summary]
Shot 1, 00:00-00:03: Camera locked low on the road shoulder, wide lens. The blue fastback blasts past the lens left to right, tyres throwing grit, a dust plume rolling across frame and drifting right with the wind.
Shot 2, 00:03-00:06: High drone wide flying right at the cars' speed. The fastback small in the lower left third on the grey road, the white pickup about fifty metres behind, the red walls towering on both sides.
Shot 3, 00:06-00:09: Inside the fastback, close on Dev at the wheel, the rear-view mirror in the upper left of frame. His eyes flick to the mirror; the white pickup grows larger in it.
Shot 4, 00:09-00:12: Camera mounted low on the pickup's front bumper, looking forward. The fastback's chrome rear bumper fills more and more of the frame as the pickup closes in.
Shot 5, 00:12-00:15: Long-lens tracking shot from a camera car alongside, both vehicles in profile. The pickup surges and its front bumper rams the fastback's rear bumper; the fastback lurches, fishtails once in a spray of grit and straightens, a fresh dent now in its rear bumper.
Shot 6, 00:15-00:18: Top-down drone directly above the S-bend. The fastback swings through both curves on the inside line, the pickup following wider, two dust ribbons tracing the S.
Shot 7, 00:18-00:21: Low tracking camera behind the fastback. The dented rear bumper bounces in the foreground; ahead, the road rises toward the crest.
Shot 8, 00:21-00:25: Wide static from the roadside beyond the crest, angled so both cars still cross left to right. The fastback hits the crest and flies with all four wheels off the ground on a short arc, lands heavily, suspension compressing deep, a burst of dust. The pickup follows, lands nose-first, its front digs in and it slews off the road onto the shoulder and stops inside its own dust cloud.
Shot 9, 00:25-00:28: Inside the fastback, medium on Dev. He breathes out and glances at the mirror: the stopped pickup shrinks behind them in the dust.
Shot 10, 00:28-00:30: Low long lens behind and to the left of the fastback as it drives on to the right into the heat haze, the dust cloud around the stalled pickup filling the left foreground. Hold.

[Audio Style]
Natural location sound only. The fastback: a deep, uneven V8 rumble rising with each gear. The pickup: a harsher, rattling engine and loose metal. Grit pelting the underbody, wind buffeting the camera, a hard metallic crunch exactly on the ram, a tyre scrub on the fishtail and through the S-bend, the engine note leaping when the wheels leave the ground, heavy thuds and spring creaks on both landings, interior cabin hum with Dev's breath, then the fastback's engine fading into wind.

[Camera Work and Core Constraints]
Ten shots, adjacent shots differing in scale, angle and move: locked low wide, drone, interior close, bumper mount, long-lens tracking, top-down drone, low rear tracking, wide static, interior medium, low long lens. Screen direction left to right holds in every exterior shot. The fastback matches @Image1–@Image3, the pickup matches @Image4, Dev matches @Image5, and the canyon matches @Image6 in every shot. After Shot 5 the dent in the fastback's rear bumper stays. Wheels roll at road speed, real suspension travel and vehicle weight, dust that trails, hangs and drifts right with the wind. Hard midday light consistent across shots. 35 mm anamorphic film look, warm red rock, fine grain, vehicles on a third.

He travels left to right in every shot. The jump obeys real ballistics: the run-up speed carries him across, gravity curves him down.

Shot 2, 00:03-00:06: Low tracking camera beside him at knee height, 24 mm. He sprints five accelerating strides along the gravel toward the edge; his last step plants his right foot squarely on top of the parapet.
Shot 3, 00:06-00:09: Wide side profile, locked-off, perpendicular to the gap, 35 mm, his whole body and both roofs in frame. Shot 4, 00:09-00:12: Low close at roof level from the front, 50 mm. His knees bend deep to absorb the landing, his momentum rolls him forward over his right shoulder and back up to his feet; gravel sprays out from the landing spot and settles.
Shot 5, 00:12-00:15: Medium from behind, handheld, 40 mm. He turns to look back across the gap at the roof he left, chest heaving, a short grin; the scattered gravel still lies around his feet.

[Audio Style]
Native sound, no music: rooftop wind, distant city traffic below, quick gravel footsteps accelerating, the scrape and grunt of the push-off, a brief rush of wind in the air, a heavy double thud of both feet landing exactly on the frame of contact, gravel skittering, the rustle of the roll, hard breathing.

items.summary_ru: Серый превиз становится сценой на футзальной арене: синий фастбэк разгоняется к огромному мячу, делает переднее сальто, бьёт мяч передним бампером, мяч влетает в ворота и остаётся в сетке. Ждём ту же траекторию и кадр удара, что в превизе, и честную физику машины, мяча и сетки.

checks.detail_ru: Путь камеры, крупность, ракурс, склейки и тайминг совпадают с превизом при наложении/покадровом сравнении (±2 кадра).
Путь машины, высота и фаза сальто, полёт мяча совпадают с превизом в каждом кадре.
Отрыв, удар бампером по мячу, касание мячом сетки и приземление машины — в те же кадры, что в превизе (±2 кадра).
Мяч влетает в ворота, сетка прогибается и гасит его, мяч остаётся внутри и не проходит сквозь сетку.
Ни одного серого бокса, манекена или нетекстурированной поверхности ни в одном кадре; всё стало объектами и локацией из рефов.
Фастбэк как PR_FASTBACK_1–3 (тёмно-синий, хром, без шильдиков), арена как LO_ARENA; ворота те же.
Колёса крутятся при разгоне и продолжают вращаться в воздухе, кузов поворачивается вокруг одной оси, мяч сжимается при ударе и улетает, подвеска сжимается при приземлении.
Рёв мотора, визг шин, глухой резиновый удар по мячу, шелест сетки, удар приземления, эхо зала; без музыки.

items.reference_mapping: @Video1 = BO_BALL (grey-box blocking previs: camera, car and ball trajectories, timing); @Image1–@Image3 = PR_FASTBACK_1..3 (three photos of the same blue fastback); @Image4 = LO_ARENA (indoor futsal arena with the goal and net)
items.prompt:
[Core Task]
[Reference Mapping] @Video1 is a grey-box 3D blocking previs: it controls camera path, framing, timing, positions and trajectories; the grey boxes become the car, the ball and the arena from the images; nothing grey remains. The grey car box becomes the fastback of @Image1–@Image3, three photos of the same unbadged 1970s two-door fastback in deep blue with chrome bumpers. The big grey sphere becomes a giant inflated football with a white and black panel pattern and no lettering. @Image4 is the indoor futsal arena: the grey set becomes this hall, and the grey goal frame becomes its goal with the net; any ramp box in @Video1 becomes a plain steel kicker ramp.
A 15-second photoreal stunt that re-renders @Video1 exactly. Match @Video1 frame by frame: the same camera path, lens feel, framing, cuts and timing, the same positions, trajectories and speeds, and every contact on the same frame as in @Video1. The times below describe the beats of @Video1; where they differ, @Video1 wins.

[Plot Summary]
Beats of @Video1, as one action in its own camera:
00:00-00:05: The fastback accelerates across the arena floor toward the giant ball on the path of @Video1, tyres gripping and spinning on the polished floor.
00:05-00:08: It leaves the ground on the frame of @Video1 and rotates forward in a front flip around one axis, wheels still spinning, on the arc and at the height of @Video1.
00:08-00:09: Contact on the exact frame of @Video1: the front bumper strikes the ball; the ball squashes against the chrome and springs away.
00:09-00:12: The ball flies on the trajectory of @Video1 into the goal; the net bulges deep, catches it and the ball drops and stays inside the net, rocking to rest.
00:12-00:15: The fastback completes the flip and lands on all four wheels on the frame of @Video1, suspension compressing hard; it skids to a stop facing the goal as in the final frame of @Video1.

[Audio Style]
Native sound, no music: the V8 revving up and echoing round the hall, tyre squeal on the polished floor, a sudden hush of engine whine in the air, a deep rubbery boom on the bumper hit, the swish and stretch of the net, a heavy suspension thud and tyre chirp on landing, the arena echo fading.

[Camera Work and Core Constraints]
Camera, framing, cuts and timing exactly as @Video1. Car path, flip arc, ball trajectory and the frames of take-off, bumper hit, net contact and landing exactly as @Video1. The car matches @Image1–@Image3 and the arena and goal match @Image4. Wheels rotate, the body turns as one rigid piece, the ball keeps its size, deforms on impact and stays in the net. Even bright arena light, photoreal film look, light grain.
